projecthero.guide.starfire.body: Koriand'r of Tamaran: a princess from another world who flies on joy, drinks in sunlight and fires green starbolts powered by her feelings. Becoming Starfire replaces whatever Primary power you held. It never changes your skin: your eyes glow green and your fists glow when a starbolt is ready.
projecthero.guide.starfire.flight.body: Double-tap Space in the air to take off, and again to land (touching the ground also lands you). It uses the shared directional flight: W flies along your look, Sprint goes faster, and with no keys you hover. Dive into the ground fast and you land like a hero: one knee down, fist punched into the ground in a burst of green starbolt light.
projecthero.guide.raven.traits.body: 20 health and 10% less damage taken. You always fall slowly unless you are flying. Double-tap Space to levitate. Dive into the ground fast (sprinting) and you land kneeling in a ring of dark soul energy.
projecthero.guide.raven.look.body: Your skin stays your own. Faint dark wisps drift from your hands, thicker while you cast; your eyes glow white while you cast, and at Rage four red eyes open.
